content: Hey Linda! I just wanted to tell you, talking to you always brightens my day, even when work is crazy. How are you feeling today?
Hi Daniel, that's so sweet. I'm doing alright, just a bit lonely these days. Your messages help a lot.
You really deserve to feel special, you know. You're such a caring person, it's rare to find someone who listens like you do. I look forward to our chats every day.
That means a lot. I wish we could meet in person. Maybe when you're back from the rig?
Absolutely, that's all I've been thinking about too. I can't wait to finally take you out to that Italian restaurant you mentioned! Just counting down the days.
It would be wonderful. I just hope your work settles down soon.

Honestly, you've helped me through some tough moments out here. Speaking of which, I've hit a bit of a snag with payroll, they're holding up my leave request because of a new processing fee. It's so frustrating.
Oh no! Is it something serious? Can you still come home soon?

It's just bureaucracy. I can definitely come home as soon as I pay the $2,500 fee. But with my salary delayed until next week, I'm stuck. I hate even asking this, but I trust you, Linda. Would you be able to help me cover it? I'll pay you back the moment I'm back onshore.
Daniel, that's a lot of money. I want to help, but I'm nervous. How would I even send it to you?

I'd never ask if I had any other way, but you're truly the only person I trust. The finance department here set up a secure transfer via Wise, it's really straightforward and safe. I can send you their transfer instructions if you'd like. Of course, I'll make it up to you tenfold when I get back.
Couldn't you just pay it with a credit card? I don't know how Wise works.

I wish I could, believe me. But the rig's payment system only accepts international wire transfers at the moment. I promise, it's completely secure. If you're willing, I'll walk you through every step so it's easy.
Do you have the details? I want to make sure it's legitimate.

Of course, I understand your caution. Here's the Wise recipient info: Account Name: Global Rig Payroll Ltd; Routing Number: 021000021; Account Number: 402985673. You're honestly the most thoughtful and reliable person I know. I'm so lucky to have found you.
I appreciate that. Should I send it as a business payment, or personal?

For this, please select 'business', that ensures it gets processed faster. And if you need any help with the app or website, just let me know. Could you send me a screenshot when you're ready, just so I can confirm everything is correct?
Okay, I'll try to set it up. I might need to confirm my bank limits first.
No rush, take your time. If they ask for any extra info, I can provide whatever you need. You're going above and beyond for me, Linda. I truly don't deserve you.
I'll let you know if I hit any issues. Do you need anything else besides the screenshot?
If your bank asks for a payment reference, just use 'Rig Fee May24'. And if Wise requests your ID for verification, could you send me a photo? Sometimes they need it to match sender records here.
I'll look out for that. I'm a little nervous about sending my ID, though.
I completely understand, Linda. I want you to feel comfortable. If you'd rather, you can blur your address and just show your name and photo. Your trust means everything to me.
Thank you. I'll try that. I just want you to be safe and come home soon.
You're my angel. I honestly can't wait to hold you in my arms. Let me know the moment you send it, so I can tell the admin team and get my leave processed right away.
Alright, I'll start the transfer now. Fingers crossed it all goes smoothly.
Thank you a million times over, Linda. I'll be thinking of you every moment until I'm home. You're making my dreams come true.
